QF.id: SIA Assessment Frameworks Techniques and Standards_16

question.text: The United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), which inform IRIS+ core-metric design, comprise how many goals?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** There are 17 SDGs adopted by UN Member States in 2015 as part of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. IRIS+ aligns its core metric sets with these 17 goals to support SDG-based impact measurement. **The Trap:** 8 MDGs preceded the SDGs (2000-2015). 12 is fabricated. Agenda-21 (1992 Rio) has 40 chapters, not 21 pillars. Only 17 SDGs fits. **Cross-Exam Context:** V-A Distributor and X-A IA touch SDGs in ESG; XXIII expects 17 SDGs as a baseline fact. **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** When mapping SE outcomes to SDGs in the AIR, pick at most 3-4 primary SDGs — scattering across all 17 dilutes narrative credibility for investors.
